title: The 2015 Pelotas (Brazil) Birth Cohort Study
brief_summary: This is the fourth birth cohort to be carried out in the city of Pelotas (Brazil) including more than 4 thousand children followed-up since the pre-natal period to study maternal-child health.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* live births
* mothers living in urban area of the city
* delivered during 2015

Exclusion Criteria:

* stillbirths below 500g
* mothers living outside Pelotas
study_population: All live births from mothers living in Pelotas during the year 2015 were included in the birth cohort to be followed-up since birth.
